name: Seared Strip Steak with Cajun Corn, Tomato & Roasted Red Pepper Sauté

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg striploin (New York strip) steak
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate and set aside to rest, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and halve tomatoes lengthwise. Place in a medium bowl.
Drain and roughly chop roasted peppers. Add to the bowl with the tomatoes.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (340 g) jars roasted red bell peppers

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large pot over medium heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add tomatoes, peppers, corn, and spices; cook, stirring frequently, until veggies are tender and corn is warmed through, 4-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
4 ½ cups frozen corn
2 tbsp Cajun seasoning
¾ tsp salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the corn sauté is done, remove pot from heat, add vinaigrette, and stir to combine.
Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, divide steak and corn sauté between plates. Enjoy!
